note: Who may authorise a data correction or revert (DI-03F). Identity is a SIGNING KEY, not a name: an approval is an OpenSSH signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign -n thriv3-correction-approval@v1) over the approval body, verified against the keys enrolled here (server/lib/refresh/approvalValidator.js). Enrolling or removing a key, or changing a scope or the policy, is itself a T2 change. scopes: the database classes (server/lib/refresh/correctionTarget.js) a reviewer may authorise. Prefer a FIDO hardware key (sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com): its signature also proves a physical touch, which no agent or script running under the reviewer's account can produce. A reviewer with no enrolled key cannot approve anything.
